name: Worry & Anxiety
overview: Scripture teaches believers to find courage and strength in the Lord, who is always present and faithful, as Joshua 1:9 encourages us not to fear or be dismayed because God is with us wherever we go. The Psalms reinforce this truth by portraying the Lord as our shepherd who provides for our needs (Psalms 23:1), our light and salvation who removes fear (Psalms 27:1), and a deliverer who hears and rescues us from all our fears (Psalms 34:4). Trusting and committing our ways to the Lord brings assurance and peace, as seen in Psalms 37:5, while ceasing from anger and fretfulness helps us avoid the destructive effects of worry and anxiety (Psalms 37:8). Together, these verses reveal a biblical response to worry and anxiety rooted in faith, trust, and reliance on God's presence and provision.
